claim_boundary: This defines and pins the neutral session-checkpoint carrier. It does not collect BACH state, restore BACH state, prove old/new output parity, modify BACH, provide a bundle or pass an off-host sluice test.

carrier.state: dedicated configurable local SQLite file owned by the module

record.id: positive local integer preserved by export/import
record.namespace: safe application token required on row operations
record.name: human-readable local name
record.payload: canonical JSON object; application-defined; default maximum 1 MiB
record.payload_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON; integrity, not authenticity
record.source_ref: optional unique migration identity within a namespace

invariants: carrier never opens or discovers an application database
carrier refuses an existing SQLite file with unrelated tables or incompatible columns
payload must be a JSON object and is verified on every get, list and export
get and delete require both numeric id and namespace
delete and import are dry-run by default in the CLI
import validates all ids, hashes and source-reference conflicts before writing any row
import defaults to at most 1000 checkpoints and 16 MiB aggregate canonical payload; the CLI reads at most 32 MiB before JSON parsing
exact repeated imports are idempotent; divergent collisions fail closed
new stores and exports use owner-only POSIX mode bits; Windows confidentiality remains the containing directory ACL
carrier performs no network access and contains no application paths or personal fixtures

collects: at most ten pending task id/title pairs
at most five newest memory_working content values

payload_fields.open_tasks: array of objects with id and title

forbidden: parallel writes to legacy session_snapshots after BACH-IN

operation_mapping.adapter_work: collect the four payload fields, choose name, namespace bach and kind manual, then translate the returned row to the legacy tuple text
pass numeric id plus namespace bach; forward dry_run and translate not-found without cross-namespace disclosure
request namespace bach, limit 20, newest first and format metadata without payloads

operation_mapping.carrier_surface: CheckpointStore.get or newest CheckpointStore.list result followed by get
operation_mapping.adapter_work: materialize and format payload only; preserve the current fact that load does not restore application state

mapping.name: legacy name
mapping.created_at: legacy created_at normalized by the migration adapter

migration.preflight: export bundle plus dry-run import; reject malformed JSON, scalar payloads, duplicate ids and source references
migration.apply: single carrier transaction after a copy-only comparison
migration.rollback: retain a hashed legacy export and support exact reverse materialization until BACH-IN is accepted
